_design_note: The analysis proposed treatment rooms with full pages against controls left in the old architecture. THAT DESIGN IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE AND THE REASON MATTERS: all 38 rooms shipped at once on 2026-08-17, because the pre-state was not thin pages but NO PAGES — /rooms/marx returned 404, and there was exactly one indexable document on the domain. A control arm would have meant deliberately leaving rooms at 404 to preserve an experiment, which is the wrong trade when the repair is known.
_what_is_measurable_instead: A BEFORE/AFTER on a single domain with a known switch date, not a randomised arm comparison. The distinction is worth stating rather than papering over: this is weaker evidence, confounded by anything else changing in the retrieval layer over the same window. The arms below are retained as STRATA, not as treatment and control — three high-document rooms against three lower-document ones, so differential gain by corpus size is still visible.
